citation.title: Combining physics-based and data-driven models for quantitatively accurate plasma profile prediction that extrapolates well; with application to DIII-D, AUG, and ITER tokamaks
citation.authors: J. Abbate, E. Fable, G. Tardini, R. Fischer, E. Kolemen, ASDEX Upgrade Team

topic: Forecasting multi-profile evolution 300 ms ahead from profiles and actuators on DIII-D and AUG, with ML/physics stacking and extrapolation from low to high Ip.
own_question: Can data-driven, physics-based, transfer-learned, multi-machine and meta-learned predictors extrapolate profile evolution to higher Ip?
actual_method_and_evidence: LSTM rollout trained with curriculum learning on 20 ms steps. Inputs are fitted profiles, including CER-derived Ti and rotation, plus actuators. Comparators are ASTRA with TGLF-nn and gyroBohm, and a hold-constant baseline. Evaluation uses the sigma metric on discharge-number-held-out sets split by Ip. Per the authors, only a weighted ML-physics stack improved on near-extrapolated ML, by about 5–10%. Near-extrapolated ML was not significantly different from holding profiles constant. Adding AUG data, transfer learning and concatenating simulation outputs showed no significant gain.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: In one DIII-D profile-forecasting study, a hold-initial-profile baseline was statistically comparable to a near-extrapolated neural predictor.
claim_checks.qualification: Covers future 300 ms profile forecasting averaged over Te and Ti. It is not current-report nowcasting and not KSTAR.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Future profiles at 20 ms steps, smoothed causally over 50 ms, within a 300 ms window. Ti is from charge exchange recombination and assumed equal across ion species. Report arrival latency is not studied.
validation_if_relevant: Discharges ending in 0 form the test set and those ending in 5 the validation set. Splits are by Ip regime. No untouched campaign is used.
forbidden_inferences: Does not support nowcasting the current CES report
Does not show that BES/ECEI informs Ti
Should not be generalized to all prior work
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Optional context showing that persistence baselines matter in profile forecasting. Its task, inputs and timing differ fundamentally from our study.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
